declared.title: Human capital and life satisfaction in economic transition: Econometric evidence from pre- and post-Arab Spring Egypt
declared.foundIn: OpenAlex search « income life satisfaction happiness Egypt » (2026-11-22)

population: Egyptian adults surveyed before and after the 2011 Arab Spring

findings.text: In Egypt, before and after 2011, people who see their income as high are more satisfied with their lives

support.sentence: Ordered logit results point to positive and significant relationships between life satisfaction and both perceived high incomes and the human capital variable, good health, for the pre- and post-Arab Spring periods in Egypt, thus confirming prior studies of transition economies.

limits: perceived income, not measured income: says nothing of a threshold or a plateau
cross-sectional: an association, not an effect of money
full text not read: survey, sample size and income bands not checked
